plan.title: 为什么清洗后的运动鞋不宜直接贴近暖气烘干？
plan.core_promise: 干燥应优先建立温和、持续的水分排出条件，而不是用局部高温追求表面快速变干。
plan.primary_carrier: a porous layered field whose outer edge is sparse and dry while a contained inner pocket remains dense, separated by an uneven interval rather than a directional path

visual_progression.entry: a low-density field of fine broken ink contours
visual_progression.development: a denser contained inner pocket held behind an uneven porous layer
visual_progression.resolution: a widened breathable interval around the dense pocket, with one tiny muted green dry-brush accent

must_show: an outer sparse region visibly distinct from a denser contained inner region
an uneven porous interval that suggests sustained release rather than abrupt heating
must_not_imply: a recognizable shoe, radiator, fan, or heating device
that high heat is the recommended drying method
a time sequence or causal mechanism not stated in the article

plan.source_support: 靠近热源时，外侧鞋面会优先升温、优先变干；但鞋头深部、鞋垫下方及内衬与中底之间的区域，仍可能保留较高湿度。
plan.intent: resolve why a dry-feeling exterior cannot confirm that the shoe is dry inside
plan.source_anchor: 靠近热源时，外侧鞋面会优先升温、优先变干；但鞋头深部、鞋垫下方及内衬与中底之间的区域，仍可能保留较高湿度。
plan.reader_block: 外层先干与内部仍湿可以同时存在，因此表面触感不能证明整双鞋已干透。
plan.source_relation: 同一只鞋的外侧鞋面先变干，与鞋头深部、鞋垫下方和内衬—中底之间仍可能较湿形成结构对照。
plan.subtitle: 表面先干，深处仍可能留湿
comparison_basis: outer shoe surface is visibly dry while enclosed inner regions retain visible moisture marks
the dry surface is outside the shoe boundary while the wetter toe, insole-below, and lining–midsole regions are contained inside it
plan.visual_solution: one small lightly-oblique cutaway running shoe with a broad slightly skewed silhouette, a lifted tongue and a single lifted insole edge; its outer upper is open white and dry, while three interior pockets—deep toe, under the insole, and the lining-to-midsole seam—hold sparse gray moisture marks. The cutaway's opening and unequal interior pockets make the exterior/interior boundary legible; one tiny green dry-brush gesture sits only in the dry outer upper.
must_show: the outer shoe surface is visibly dry and separate from the interior
three enclosed interior regions remain visibly wetter: deep toe, beneath the insole, and the lining–midsole interface
the dry and wetter states belong to one continuous shoe structure, not two separate shoes
must_not_imply: that every shoe will retain moisture in exactly the same locations
that touching the exterior is a sufficient dryness test
a measured moisture level or a medical claim

local_colours.rationale: locally distinguishes the already-dry exterior without assigning a factual material colour

visible_evidence: an open white outer upper lies outside the shoe boundary while three gray moisture-marked pockets are visibly enclosed within the cutaway
the lifted tongue and insole edge reveal the interior as continuous with the outer shoe rather than as a second alternative object

continuity_rules: all visible upper, tongue, insole, lining, midsole, and outsole parts belong to one connected shoe
the lifted insole edge remains connected to the shoe opening

plan.source_support: 先取出鞋垫，松开鞋带并拉开鞋舌；用干毛巾轻压鞋内可见积水，避免反复扭拧鞋面或中底；随后将鞋放在阴凉、干燥且空气流动的位置，使空气能够从鞋口进入，并带走蒸发出的水汽。
plan.intent: resolve the safer sequence for drying a wet shoe
plan.source_anchor: 先取出鞋垫，松开鞋带并拉开鞋舌；用干毛巾轻压鞋内可见积水，避免反复扭拧鞋面或中底；随后将鞋放在阴凉、干燥且空气流动的位置，使空气能够从鞋口进入，并带走蒸发出的水汽。
plan.reader_block: 更稳妥的干燥靠打开结构、轻压吸水与持续通风的顺序，而不是局部加热。
plan.source_relation: 取出鞋垫并拉开鞋舌后，先以干毛巾轻压可见积水，再让空气从鞋口进入并带走水汽，构成前后相接的处理流程。
plan.subtitle: 先减自由水，再维持空气流动
plan.visual_solution: three small connected vignettes in an uneven left-to-right diagonal: first one open shoe with loosened laces, lifted tongue, and its insole removed beside it; second the same shoe is gently pressed with a folded dry towel at the opening; third the open shoe is placed in sparse moving air entering the opening and carrying away a few small moisture marks. Keep all three states as one shoe sequence, shallow and hand-drawn.
must_show: the first state visibly opens the shoe by removing the insole and loosening the tongue and laces
the second state visibly uses a dry towel to press visible water without twisting the shoe
the final state visibly shows air entering the shoe opening and moisture leaving it
must_not_imply: direct heating, hot air, or a radiator
that the sequence is an instant drying guarantee

local_colours.target: the single local air-entry directional line at the shoe opening

visible_evidence: three visibly ordered shoe states are connected left to right by two fine directional lines
each state changes a distinct source-supported condition: open structure, towel pressure, then airflow through the opening

continuity_rules: each vignette depicts a complete instance of the same shoe at a different sequential state
the insole appears only as the intentionally removed accessory beside the first state
the towel remains a single folded connected cloth

plan.source_support: 贴近暖气或热风出口时，受热侧与背阴侧会形成明显温差。织物、合成革、EVA 等泡棉材料、橡胶和胶黏层会以不同速度升温和形变；当温度分布不均且持续时间较长时，鞋面起皱、泡棉局部收缩、鞋型偏移或粘接界面性能下降的风险都会增加。
plan.intent: resolve why direct local heat creates a material-risk difference across one shoe
plan.source_anchor: 贴近暖气或热风出口时，受热侧与背阴侧会形成明显温差。织物、合成革、EVA 等泡棉材料、橡胶和胶黏层会以不同速度升温和形变；当温度分布不均且持续时间较长时，鞋面起皱、泡棉局部收缩、鞋型偏移或粘接界面性能下降的风险都会增加。
plan.reader_block: 局部热源让鞋的两侧处于不同热条件，复合材料因不同步变化而增加鞋面、泡棉、鞋型与粘接界面的风险。
plan.source_relation: 同一只鞋贴近局部热源时，受热侧与背阴侧形成温差；不同材料以不同速度升温和形变，风险集中在受热侧相关的鞋面、泡棉和粘接界面。
plan.core_judgment: 局部高温，会拉大材料负担
plan.subtitle: 受热侧与背阴侧的反应并不同步
comparison_basis: the heat-facing side is visibly adjacent to a localized heat outlet and has a wrinkled upper, contracted foam edge, and slightly lifted bonding seam
the shaded side remains visibly separated from the heat outlet and retains a smoother upper, fuller foam edge, and continuous bonding seam
plan.visual_solution: one small lightly-oblique running shoe shown as a continuous split exposure: its left side sits near a plain low-detail heat outlet that emits three short gray heat strokes, while its right side remains in open white space. The heat-facing upper has a few loose wrinkles, its midsole edge is slightly pinched, and a small sole-to-upper seam lifts at the edge; the far side remains smooth, full, and joined. Keep the shoe's short broad silhouette and open tongue readable, with a single tiny green dry-brush gesture only at the boundary between the two exposure zones.
must_show: one side of the shoe is visibly nearer the localized heat outlet while the opposite side is visibly away from it
the near side visibly differs through a wrinkled upper, a pinched foam edge, and a small lifted bonding seam
the far side remains visibly smoother, fuller, and continuously joined as the contrast condition
must_not_imply: a specific safe or unsafe temperature value
that every material will deform identically
that the shoe has already failed or cannot be used

local_colours.target: the narrow boundary between the heat-facing and shaded conditions
local_colours.rationale: quietly marks the source-supported contrast without encoding temperature as a factual color

visible_evidence: the heat outlet and its short strokes are adjacent only to the visibly changed side of the one shoe
the changed and unchanged shoe edges are structurally contrasted by wrinkles, foam profile, and bonding continuity rather than by labels alone

continuity_rules: all visible upper, tongue, foam, outsole, and bonding seam parts belong to one connected shoe
the heat outlet remains a separate simple object and does not merge with the shoe

plan.source_support: 合理晾干通常需要更长时间，但能同时兼顾鞋内干燥、粘接稳定和鞋型保持。
plan.intent: resolve the three linked outcomes of patient, reasonable drying
plan.source_anchor: 合理晾干通常需要更长时间，但能同时兼顾鞋内干燥、粘接稳定和鞋型保持。
plan.reader_block: 合理晾干的价值不是立刻变干，而是在更长时间内同时保住内部干燥、粘接稳定和鞋型。
plan.source_relation: 合理晾干这一处理方式同时关联鞋内干燥、粘接稳定和鞋型保持三项结果，且以更长时间为代价。
plan.core_judgment: 慢一点，才能兼顾三件事
plan.subtitle: 鞋内干燥、粘接稳定、鞋型保持
plan.visual_solution: one small open shoe in the center with a lifted tongue and a visible insole edge, surrounded by three uneven but connected outcome details: a dry open interior at upper left, one continuous sole-to-upper seam at lower center, and a stable broad shoe silhouette at upper right. Use three calm hairline connectors from the one shoe to the three details; a small quiet non-directional curve below the shoe suggests time passing without becoming a route or timeline.
must_show: one open shoe is visibly connected to three distinct outcome details
the three details visibly show a dry interior, a continuous bonding seam, and a stable shoe silhouette
the composition makes the three outcomes simultaneous rather than a sequence of steps
must_not_imply: that these three checks replace brand-specific care guidance

local_colours.target: the single open interior edge of the central shoe
local_colours.rationale: locally focuses the reader on the source-supported dry interior without making it a material claim

visible_evidence: three hairline connectors link the same central shoe to three visibly distinct and labeled outcome details
the links have no arrowheads and the three outcome details sit concurrently around the shoe rather than in a time order

continuity_rules: all visible central shoe parts remain one connected shoe
each outcome detail is a close semantic detail of the same shoe rather than a detached second shoe
